appName: My Hand is a Goose Demo
displayName: My Hand is a Goose Demo
display_name: My Hand is a Goose Demo
display_long_description:
Your hand is a goose.

In My hand is a Goose, you stretch your neck, open your beak, and snap up whatever you can reach. Steal bread. Scoop up little geese. Carry them home to the nest before they wander off—or before the bread falls in the water.

This is a playful hand-tracking puzzle adventure built for Meta Quest. Every level asks you to think with your hands: stretch farther, grab smarter, and use tools when your beak alone isn’t enough.

WHAT YOU’LL DO
• Stretch and snap — Control a goose head with your real hands. Bite bread, catch goslings, and deliver them to the nest.
• Solve nest puzzles — Push bread with a brush, and time grabs on moving platforms.
• Rescue the flock — Later levels mix bread heists with swimming little geese that need a ride home.
• Play offline, solo — No accounts, no online required. Just you, your hands, and a very hungry goose.

FEATURES
• Full hand-tracking gameplay
• Multiple puzzle levels with escalating challenges
• Physics-based grabbing, tools, and moving platforms
• Cute goose vibes with satisfying snap-and-deliver moments

Become the goose. Fill the nest. Don’t drop the bread.
